features.name: Celestial Resistance
features.desc: You have resistance to Radiant damage and Necrotic damage.

features.name: Darkvision
features.desc: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

features.name: Healing Hands
features.desc: As an Action, you can touch a creature and restore HP. Once per Long Rest.

features.name: Light Bearer
features.desc: You know the Light cantrip. Charisma is your spellcasting ability.

features.name: Celestial Revelation
features.desc: Bonus Action: Transform for 1 min. Once per Long Rest. Choose your revelation each time you transform.

variants.name: Heavenly Wings
variants.desc: You gain a Fly Speed equal to your Speed.

variants.name: Inner Radiance
variants.desc: At the end of your turns, creatures within 10ft take PB Radiant damage.

variants.name: Necrotic Shroud
variants.desc: Once per turn, deal extra Necrotic damage. Nearby creatures may be Frightened.

features.name: Breath Weapon
features.desc: Replace one attack with a 15-ft cone or 30-ft line. DC 8 + Con + PB. Half damage on save. Uses = PB per Long Rest.

features.name: Draconic Ancestry
features.desc: Determines your breath damage and resistance (see Variants).

features.name: Draconic Flight
features.desc: Bonus Action: Gain fly speed for 10 mins. Once per Long Rest.

variants.name: Black Dragon
variants.desc: Acid Resistance;

variants.name: Blue Dragon
variants.desc: Lightning Resistance;

variants.name: Brass Dragon
variants.desc: Fire Resistance;

variants.name: Bronze Dragon
variants.desc: Lightning Resistance;

variants.name: Copper Dragon
variants.desc: Acid Resistance;

variants.name: Gold Dragon
variants.desc: Fire Resistance;

variants.name: Green Dragon
variants.desc: Poison Resistance;

variants.name: Red Dragon
variants.desc: Fire Resistance;

variants.name: Silver Dragon
variants.desc: Cold Resistance;

variants.name: White Dragon
variants.desc: Cold Resistance;

features.name: Fey Ancestry
features.desc: Adv on saves vs Charm; magic can't put you to sleep.

features.name: Keen Senses
features.desc: Proficiency in Insight, Perception, or Survival.

features.name: Elven Lineage
features.desc: Choose your lineage for specific magic.

variants.name: Drow
variants.desc: Darkvision 120ft; Dancing Lights (1), Faerie Fire (3), Darkness (5).

variants.name: High Elf
variants.desc: Prestidigitation (1 - swap on rest); Detect Magic (3), Misty Step (5).

variants.name: Wood Elf
variants.desc: Speed 35ft; Druidcraft (1), Longstrider (3), Pass Without Trace (5).

features.name: Gnomish Cunning
features.desc: Adv on Int, Wis, and Cha saving throws.

features.name: Gnomish Lineage
features.desc: Choose your lineage for specific magic.

variants.name: Forest Gnome
variants.desc: Minor Illusion cantrip; Speak with Animals always prepared.

variants.name: Rock Gnome
variants.desc: Mending and Prestidigitation cantrips; create tiny clockwork devices.

features.name: Giant Ancestry
features.desc: Choose your ancestry for combat benefits. Uses = PB per Long Rest.

features.name: Powerful Build
features.desc: Adv on saves vs Grappled. Count as one size larger for carrying.

features.name: Large Form
features.desc: Bonus Action: Become Large for 10 mins. Adv on Str checks, +10 speed. Once per Long Rest.

variants.name: Cloud Giant
variants.desc: Bonus Action: Teleport 30ft.

variants.name: Fire Giant
variants.desc: On hit: Deal extra 1d10 Fire damage.

variants.name: Frost Giant
variants.desc: On hit: Deal extra 1d6 Cold damage and reduce target speed by 10ft.

variants.name: Hill Giant
variants.desc: On hit: Force target to be knocked Prone.

variants.name: Stone Giant
variants.desc: Reaction when hit: Reduce damage by 1d12 + Con.

variants.name: Storm Giant
variants.desc: Reaction when hit: Attacker takes 1d8 Thunder damage.

features.name: Fiendish Legacy
features.desc: Choose your legacy for resistance and magic.

variants.name: Abyssal
variants.desc: Poison Resistance; Poison Spray (1), Ray of Sickness (3), Hold Person (5).

variants.name: Chthonic
variants.desc: Necrotic Resistance; Chill Touch (1), False Life (3), Ray of Enfeeblement (5).

variants.name: Infernal
variants.desc: Fire Resistance; Fire Bolt (1), Hellish Rebuke (3), Darkness (5).
